value.rationale: Headline is finite-order flattening of the frozen equal-spaced q-gon range, explicitly necessary but not sufficient for a true smooth rational caustic (needs pinned-minimal perimeter, reflection law, smoothness, all-orders convergence). It is neither a rigidity proof nor a certified coexistence table. The q|k rule restates standard linear theory; the -1/4 coefficient is a fitted proxy parameter for modes 20/40 vs 30/60 at k=10 with only a numerically tiny proxy-residual improvement and no demonstrated downstream use for true 1/4+1/6 caustics. Under STANDARD this is a textbook restatement plus parameter fit on an artificial object, not an independently retrievable exact invariant of a natural object.
